name: Warrior II
steps: Step your feet wide apart, front foot pointing forward and back foot turned out about ninety degrees.
Bend the front knee until it sits directly over the ankle, keeping the shin vertical.
Keep the back leg straight and press through the outer edge of the back foot.
Extend both arms to shoulder height, reaching in opposite directions, torso upright between them.
Turn your head to look over the front hand and hold, breathing steadily.

name: Standing Forward Fold
steps: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart, knees soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, letting your torso hang down rather than rounding from the waist.
Let your head and neck relax completely, and rest your hands on the floor, your shins, or opposite elbows.
Straighten the knees only as far as the hamstrings allow without the lower back rounding.
Hold and breathe, letting the fold deepen on each exhale.
